G3_faithfulness.justification: Because the Radar Rover follows priority order and the Sampling Rover always selects the highest-priority waiting sector, both rovers process sectors in the same chosen order as in the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The expedition terminology is coherent and readable, though the added priority and operational wording is somewhat more elaborate than necessary.
